title: What Have You Been Working On?

pre.zh: Rachel 家的 Wi-Fi 最后是怎么好的？
options: She turns it off and on again.

intro: 每周一次的一对一视频通话：组长 Rachel 问小陈这周在忙什么。对话里有不少 so … that 和 such … that，用来说「太…，以至于…」，把一件事的程度和后果一口气说出来；也留意 have been doing（一直在做）在工作对话里有多常见。

sentences.en: So, Chen, what have you been working on this week?
sentences.zh: 那么小陈，你这周在忙什么？
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I've been trying to fix a layout bug for three days.
sentences.zh: 我在修一个布局 bug，已经修了三天了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's such a strange bug that I've started dreaming about it.
sentences.zh: 这个 bug 怪得很，我都开始做梦梦见它了。

sentences.en: Three days?
sentences.zh: 三天？
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: It must be a nasty one.
sentences.zh: 那肯定很难缠。

sentences.en: It only happens on older iPhones.
sentences.zh: 它只在老款 iPhone 上出现。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Somehow the Save button moves so far to the right that you can't see it.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，保存按钮往右偏得太远，根本看不见。

sentences.en: Every time I fix one screen, it's as good as new.
sentences.zh: 每次修好一个页面，看着是彻底没毛病了。

sentences.en: And then I run into the same problem on another one.
sentences.zh: 然后换个页面，又碰上同样的问题。

sentences.en: I still can't figure out why.
sentences.zh: 我到现在都搞不明白为什么。

sentences.en: Have you been working late again?
sentences.zh: 你是不是又熬夜加班了？
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Last night I was so tired that I nodded off at my desk.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我累得在桌前打起了瞌睡。

sentences.en: I'm just really nervous about the deadline.
sentences.zh: 主要是截止日期快到了，我特别紧张。

sentences.en: The release is supposed to be next Friday, and we're behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 按计划下周五就要发版，可我们进度已经落后了。

sentences.en: OK, take it easy tonight.
sentences.zh: 好了，今晚放松一下。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: Put your feet up and don't open your laptop.
sentences.zh: 好好歇着，别碰电脑。

sentences.en: Actually, Arjun ran into exactly the same bug last year, and he fixed it in an hour.
sentences.zh: 其实 Arjun 去年碰到过一模一样的 bug，一个小时就搞定了。

sentences.en: Shall we call him together tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 明天我们一起给他打个电话？

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Everyone's so busy that I didn't want to bother anyone.
sentences.zh: 大家都那么忙，我不想去打扰别人。

sentences.en: Here's a tip, then.
sentences.zh: 那给你个建议。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: If you're stuck for an hour, take a break.
sentences.zh: 要是卡了一个小时，就先歇一歇。

sentences.en: Then ask for help — after an hour, not three days.
sentences.zh: 然后找人帮忙——一个小时就该找，别拖三天。

sentences.en: OK, I'll give it a try.
sentences.zh: 好，我试试。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: To be honest, I'm not much better myself.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我自己也好不到哪去。

sentences.en: I've been trying to fix my Wi-Fi at home for a week.
sentences.zh: 家里的 Wi-Fi 我已经折腾一个星期了。

sentences.en: It's so slow that I've almost given up.
sentences.zh: 慢得我都快放弃了。

sentences.en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
sentences.zh: 你试过关掉再重开吗？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Chen, please.
sentences.zh: 小陈，拜托。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I'm not a beginner.
sentences.zh: 我又不是新手。

sentences.en: Give me a second.
sentences.zh: 等我一下。

sentences.en: Rachel?
sentences.zh: Rachel？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's working.
sentences.zh: ……好了，能用了。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

cards.note: to spend time doing, making or improving something
cards.tip: 问别人在忙什么，最常说 What are you working on?；on 别丢。work at 后面接单位或地点：She works at Google。
cards.example: I'm working on the new sign-up screens this sprint.

cards.note: 界面元素怎么摆放就是 layout；layout bug 指界面错位、重叠之类的问题。
口语里常说问题、病、意外「很麻烦」：a nasty bug、a nasty cold、a nasty surprise。
in very good condition again, almost like something new
to experience a problem or difficulty, often one you did not expect
cards.tip: run into a problem / trouble 遇到麻烦；run into sb 是碰巧遇见某人。过去式是 ran，过去分词是 run。
cards.example: We ran into a problem with the payment API last night.

cards.note: to understand or solve something after thinking about it
cards.tip: 后面常接 why / how / what 从句；代词放中间：figure it out。find out 是打听、查到事实，figure out 是自己想明白。
cards.example: It took us an hour to figure out why the build was failing.

cards.note: to fall asleep without meaning to, especially when sitting
to feel worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen
cards.tip: about 后面接名词或 doing：nervous about speaking。nervous 是「紧张、担心」，不是「神经质」。
cards.example: I'm a bit nervous about my first presentation in English.

cards.note: 按时完成是 meet a deadline，错过期限是 miss a deadline。
也能当动词：We release a new version every two weeks. 更新说明叫 release notes。
used to say what someone should do because of a rule, a plan or what others expect
later than planned
cards.tip: 反义是 ahead of schedule（提前）；按计划进行是 on schedule。落后多少放前面：two weeks behind schedule。
cards.example: The project is two weeks behind schedule.

cards.note: to relax and not work too hard
cards.tip: it 是固定的，不能换；也常用来劝人别着急、别生气：Take it easy!（别急！）
cards.example: The doctor told me to take it easy for a few days.

cards.note: to sit down and relax, often with your feet resting on something
打扰别人时常这样开口：Sorry to bother you, but …；Don't bother. 是「不用麻烦了」。
to stop working or doing something for a short time
cards.tip: 英式英语也常说 have a break；歇多久放在 break 前面：a ten-minute break。
cards.example: Let's take a ten-minute break and come back at three.

cards.note: to tell someone that you need them to help you
cards.tip: 向谁求助，人放中间：ask Arjun for help；for 不能丢，不说 ask help。
cards.example: Don't be afraid to ask for help in your first month.

cards.note: to try doing something to see if it works or if you like it
cards.tip: 英式英语也常说 give it a go；it 可以换成具体的东西：give the new app a try。
cards.example: I've never used this tool, but I'll give it a try.

cards.note: used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
to stop trying to do something because it is too difficult
a complete beginner 纯新手；beginner's luck 新手的好运气。
